claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Estradiol cypionate is expected to be largely inactive at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen; its estrogen receptor agonist activity produces cytostatic/antiproliferative effects on vascular smooth muscle and growth plate chondrocytes rather than broad cancer cell killing.
